messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I see the issue now. Your Airplane Mode is ON, which disables all wireless communications including cellular service. This is why you have no signal and can't send MMS. Let's fix this step by step.

First, please turn off Airplane Mode by using `toggle_airplane_mode()` on your phone. This will enable your cellular radio again.

After you do this, let me know what happens, and then we'll check your SIM status and network connection.

I turned off Airplane Mode. But it seems the status bar is showing no signal and data is disabled now. What should I do next? I'm worried about my phone not working at all.

Please process the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
